quality.review_scope: Local reported preparations, precursor chemistry, post-treatment and selected source comparison/characterization contexts; no complete-paper Reader or imported cited methods.
missing_fields: No source atomic coordinates or complete unit cell.
Record IDs index reported contexts, not independently established physical batch IDs.
Table is a partial fraction of studied samples. Individual recipe charges, precursor purity, QY measurement method and exact physical batch IDs not supplied.
conflicts: Table S1 footnote a marks TES/TBS handling sensitivity around the TBS first-group etched QY 4% decrease. Its final sentence says other etched samples were processed in air and brightened, whereas main text describes air quenching and glovebox processing. Preserve the in-air wording as an unresolved source conflict.
